paragraphs: On Sunday afternoon, Tom was bored. It was hot, and he had nothing to do. Then a new email came from his pen pal, Alex. Tom read it with Lily. "Dear Tom, I am glad that you write to me." "This is my invitation to a game called Camp Fun." "Click the link, and play with your sister." "Your friend, Alex." Tom was happy, because he did not often get an invitation like this one.

The first screen opened with a picture of a green field and a lake. "Welcome to Camp Fun! Click Play." Lily clicked Play. The second screen showed a big list. "Pack your bag. Choose three things: a tent, a flashlight, wood, a book, or a ball." "We need a tent, because we want to sleep," said Tom. "And we need wood for the fire," said Lily.

Lily chose the tent, the wood, and the book. A new screen came, and it was dark. The screen said, "It is night, and nobody can find the tent anymore. Try again." "We forgot the flashlight!" said Lily. "A book is not as useful as a flashlight," said Tom. This time, Lily chose the tent, the wood, and the flashlight. The screen said, "Great! Level two."

Level two showed a small camp next to the lake. The instructions said, "Make a fire. Click the wood three times." Tom clicked the wood two times, and nothing happened. "Click once more," said Lily. Tom clicked a third time, and a small orange fire appeared. The screen said, "Well done! The camp is warm." The fire made a small red light on the water of the lake. Then it said, "Now put up the tent."

Mom came into the room and asked, "What are you playing?" "It is a camping game from Alex," said Lily. "We are on level two, and we have a fire." Tom was not bored anymore. He wrote a short answer to Alex. "Dear Alex, thank you for the invitation. We love Camp Fun, and we will play level three tomorrow. Your friend, Tom."
